blurb: The Vitality Place offers dance classes for ages 3-18 with a season from September to June including an end-of-year recital. They also provide various fitness classes including barre, yoga, and cardio, as well as online subscriptions for dance, yoga, barre, and meditation courses. The dance program includes multiple styles and levels, with a recital event at a local performing arts center.
extraNote: Class passes expire one year from purchase, non-refundable and non-transferable · Unlimited plans are non-refundable and non-transferable with cancellation fees for early termination · Dance registration requires first month’s tuition plus registration fee ($50) · Recital tickets are non-refundable and sold on Eventbrite · September through June
